simple.summary: יַפְלֵט (Yaphlêṭ) means Japhlet , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 7 32.

definitions.full: H3310. Yaphlet יַפְלֵט proper name, masculine Asherite (on form compare Ba NB 144, 166 ); — 1Chr 7:33 (twice in verse), also 7:32 (Gi יַפְלָט ); Ιφαμηλ , Αφαληκ ,etc., Α Ιαφαλητ .
